text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad. Right before the race, 
my heart was pounding like crazy."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"What if I can't put on a cool run...? 
What if I lose again, and the fans still 
don't care whether I win or lose...?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"There were plenty of fans in the paddock. 
But the ones who were actually looking 
forward to my running were probably..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—No, my Trainer believes in me. (And so 
does Ma and everyone back home who's 
always rooting for me, of course!)"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That's why... I'll definitely make all 
my hard work pay off! I've made up my 
mind!"
